narratives.body: TNT Sports reports that AC Milan collapsed 0-3 against Bournemouth in the Europa League after goalkeeper Maignan received a red card. LiveScore notes that Bournemouth stunned Milan with an early lead, while FOX 44 and Ottumwa Courier confirm Bournemouth beat the 10-man Rossoneri. TNT Sports further describes the match as 'absolutely farcical' due to Milan's failure to make a substitution after Maignan's dismissal.
narratives.headline: AC Milan: Europa League collapse

narratives.body: LiveScore reports that Milan defender Pavlovic insists the team is 'on the right track' despite admitting 'too many mistakes' were made during the match. Football Italia adds that the injury to Gonçalo Ramos has opened the door for Italian youngsters, while another outlet warns of a lengthy lay-off for Chukwueze, creating a selection crisis for manager Amorim.
narratives.headline: AC Milan: post-match reactions and injuries

narratives.body: La Gazzetta dello Sport reports that AC Milan and Arsenal have made a move for player Tresoldi, with a valuation of 60 million euros as early as January. OneFootball suggests Milan may recall Athekame in January, though an early exit in the league is deemed unlikely. TribalFootball notes that Milan is eager to secure Rabiot's future with a fresh contract.
narratives.headline: AC Milan: transfer news and squad updates
